Class FrameHeader

java.lang.Object
org.roux.frame.FrameHeader
public final class FrameHeader extends Object
The FrameHeader type reads and writes the 56-byte header in front of a message payload. The payload is the text encoding that follows the header. The header stores the padded length, the type, the flags, and the role. The header stores the message id, the time, the token count, and the payload length. The header stores a CRC32C checksum of the payload. The header stores the two identity longs. Those longs start on an 8-byte boundary. Pad bytes after the payload bring the frame to a multiple of 8. The type refuses construction. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#FrameHeader roux-v1.md

    • write

      public static void write(MemorySegment segment, long offset, int total, byte type, byte role, long messageId, long ts, int tokens, RouxId rouxId, byte[] payload)
      The method writes one frame at the given offset. The flags byte is set to 1. The pad byte in the header is set to 0. The checksum is the CRC32C value of the payload. A null identity writes two zero longs. Bytes after the payload are set to 0 until the padded length. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#FrameHeader roux-v1.md
      Parameters:
      segment - The segment is the page.
      offset - The offset is the first byte of the frame.
      total - The total is the padded frame length.
      type - The type is the frame type byte.
      role - The role is the role byte.
      messageId - The message id is the number that locates the frame.
      ts - The time is the epoch milliseconds stored with the message.
      tokens - The token count is the number stored with the message.
      rouxId - The identity is the RouxId, or null.
      payload - The payload is the encoded message bytes.
